deed_info.dimensions: Tract Two - Lot 11, Block 76 (frontage on Kings Highway West)

raw_ocr_text:
Land and premises situate in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden, State of New Jersey being more particularly bounded and described as follows:

TRACT TWO
Beginning at a point in the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West, also known as Main Street (66.00 feet wide), said point being South 59 degrees 02 minutes 00 seconds West, a distance of 163.90 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 11 and 11.01, Block 76 on the current tax map of the Borough of Haddonfield; thence

(1) South 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds East along the aforementioned division line between Lots 11 and 11.01, Block 76 a distance of 164.01 feet to a point; thence

(2) South 12 degrees 00 minutes 41 seconds West, a distance of 31.69 feet to a point in the line of Lot 10, Block 76; thence

(3) North 32 degrees 22 minutes 35 seconds West along the division line between Lots 10 and 11, Block 76, a distance of 187.20 feet to a point in the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West; thence

(4) North 59 degrees 02 minutes 00 seconds East along the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West, a distance of 22.17 feet to the point and place of beginning.

critical_assertions.note: This is the narrow strip lot (22.17 ft frontage on Kings Highway) that was the old Lot 11. It extends ~164-187 ft deep behind the main 8 Kings Highway building.

common_failure_modes: POB description uses 'S 59d02m W, a distance of 163.90 feet' which is a reference bearing to locate the POB, not a call
Call (2) has no 'along' description - just a bearing and distance
notes: Tract Two (Lot 11) was transferred from MSSK LLC to 12 Kings Highway LLC. This is the Kings Highway frontage portion of the original 8 Kings Highway property. Narrow irregular quadrilateral shape with 22.17 ft frontage on Kings Highway and ~164-187 ft depth.
